content: {"like":["Values humor and originality in entertainment, especially in unexpected formats like modern-style jousts and futuristic medieval music.","Prefers strong, memorable performances and well-acted characters, particularly in ensemble casts with good chemistry.","Enjoys films that blend realistic CGI with engaging storytelling and satisfying conclusions.","Appreciates thoughtful social commentary and educational content that offers practical insights.","Seeks high production quality in costumes, special effects, and overall visual appeal."],"dislike":["Dislikes predictability and lack of originality in plot and dialogue.","Avoids content that relies heavily on clichés, obscenities, or infantile humor.","Prefers intelligent, erudite writing and direction over simplistic or mediocre performances.","Finds films with weak character development or poor casting to be unengaging.","Rejects movies that feel pretentious, cruel, or wasteful of time."]}
